options.text: Got any work that needs doing here?

steps.player: Got any work that needs doing here?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Well, it just so happens that I'm looking for a rough, tough, piratical type for an adventure on the high seas!

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: And I'm happy to say...
If the player does not meet the requirements for Prying Times:

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: ... it isn't you!
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Prying Times miniquest.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: ... it is you!
If the player's recommended combat is lower than 10:
Before starting this miniquest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 10.

steps.player: Great! So what do you need?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Hoist your mast, [player name], because there's some pirate looty just begging to be uncovered in a far off land! Thanks to me, you could be one of the privileged few to get your hands on it!

steps.player: Looty? You mean treasure?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Yarr!

steps.player: Well, I can't say no to a bit of treasure. What do I need to do?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Shiver me timbers! There is a crate full of high value goods just sitting at the port of Sarim!

steps.player: Port Sarim? I thought you said far off land?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Aye! The far off land of Sarim!

steps.player: Okay... but surely if this is pirate treasure, someone would have noticed... Port Sarim is a busy place.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Luckily for us, a cunning Jolly Roger of a pirate has disguised it to look like a normal crate of cargo!

steps.player: Hang on... is this actually just a normal cargo delivery? You know there's a notice board on the docks for that sort of thing...

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Normal?! Normal?! What kind of scallywag are you? There's nothing normal about a valuable crate of precious plundered pirate looty!

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Besides, you've already said you'll do it, and pirates never go back on their word.

steps.player: I'm fairly certain they do, but fine. I'll go collect this crate for you.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Me hearty goes out to you! Once you have the looty, just leave it with the port master here. Now, give me your log and I'll write out the details.
If the player doesn't have the log:
If the player has max port tasks taken:
You hand your log to Steve and he flicks through the pages. After a moment, he hands it back without writing anything in it.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Bit of a problem, I'm afraid! It seems your log is already full! You should get some of this work done before you take on my critical pirate task!
You hand your log to Steve and he updates it with details on his request.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Now, get to it, sailor! Heave to and ballast your grog!
You have accepted the Pandemonium pirate looty delivery port task.

steps.player: Actually, I've changed my mind. Maybe another time.

retrieving-and-depositing-the-pirate-loo.text: Thanks, sailor. I'll get that all sorted out.

options.text: I delivered that cargo for you.

steps.player: I delivered that cargo for you.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Shiver me timbers! That was fast!

steps.player: So could I have some 'looty' now?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Blistering barnacles! You thought that was it? You are too funny, fellow sailor!

steps.player: I get the feeling you're about to ask me to do something else...

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Aye! This is no ordinary crate, [player name]. This is a pirate crate! Only a special key can open it for us!

steps.player: But it is an ordinary crate, Steve. There was even a label on it addressed to you.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: I hope you're not trying to call Squawking Steve Beanie a liar?! That crate is pirate looty, and anything suggesting otherwise is clearly a plot by my rival pirate captains!

steps.player: Right... So what's this special key then?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: It is something very few can forge! I suspect we will require the help of a master scallywag smith!

steps.player: Is it essential that they be a scallywag as well as a smith? If not, I know of a dwarf near Mudskipper Point who might be able to help us.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: A dwarf? Yarr! That's an acceptable compromise! Ready your port side and go see this dwarf!

steps.player: Okay, I'll grab a redberry pie and go visit Thurgo...

options.text: Could you tell me about the Pandemonium's one rule?
About that crate that needs opening...

steps.player: About that crate that needs opening...

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Do you have our special key yet?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Then ready your port side and go see that dwarf!

options.text: Could you tell me about the Pandemonium's one rule?
Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
What is that cape you're wearing?
I need some help with a 'special key'.

steps.player: I need some help with a 'special key'.

steps.speaker: Thurgo
steps.text: A key? What for?

steps.player: Well, truth be told, I'm not sure it's really a key that I need. I just need something that can open a crate.

steps.speaker: Thurgo
steps.text: Ah, well a crowbar should do that. It's a simple tool.

steps.player: Can you help me make one?

steps.speaker: Thurgo
steps.text: I can indeed. We'll need a hammer, a steel bar, and of course, a redberry pie.
If the player does not have all of the materials:

steps.player: I don't have all of that I'm afraid...

steps.speaker: Thurgo
steps.text: Well, come back when you do.
You hammer a crowbar out of your steel bar, while Thurgo directs you with a pie-filled mouth.
a crowbar

steps.speaker: Thurgo
steps.text: That should do nicely.

steps.player: Thanks! I should probably see what Steve makes of this.

making-a-key-attempting-to-open-the-crat.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
making-a-key-attempting-to-open-the-crat.text: Stop! We aren't ready to open that yet!

options.text: I made that 'special key' you needed.

steps.player: I made that 'special key' you needed.

steps.text: You show Steve the crowbar.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Aha! There she crows! This is perfect!

steps.player: I'm glad you approve. Shall I use it to crack this crate open?

steps.text: You raise the crowbar hopefully.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Wait!
You lower the crowbar dejectedly.

steps.player: What's wrong?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: An artifact of this power needs a test before we try it on our precious looty!

steps.player: Fine. What should I test it on?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: I noticed a crate of grog floating around by the north westmost island of the Pandemonium. Cast off your keel and sail your vessel over there.

steps.player: And then?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Well, you open it with your new key and sample the contents, of course.

steps.player: Why would I even want to do that? How do you even know it's drinkable?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: I'm a true pirate, so I know good grog when I see it. As for why, no sailor has truly experienced the sea until they have drunk everything it has to offer.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: In fact, you should keep a log of it all. I know I do!

steps.player: Okay... this doesn't seem very healthy, but fine.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Yarr! That's the spirit!

options.text: Could you tell me about the Pandemonium's one rule?

steps.player: About that crate...

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: Have you sampled that grog yet, sailor?

steps.player: Not yet. Where can I find it again?

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
steps.text: I saw it floating around by the north westmost island of the Pandemonium. Cast off your keel and sail your vessel over there.

steps.player: Alright, I'll be back soon.

steps.player: I have. Did you know that troll was going to jump out and attack me? I had the fright of my life!

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie

steps.player: Of course it does. Right, no more wasting time. I'm assuming that's the crate next to you? I'm opening it.

steps.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie

finishing-up-opening-the-crate-next-to-s.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
finishing-up-opening-the-crate-next-to-s.text: Now, with your new looty in hand, you're ready to take on the seas like never before! Soon you'll be as great a sailor as me! Speaking of which, you're not still using that raft, are you?

finishing-up-opening-the-crate-next-to-s.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
finishing-up-opening-the-crate-next-to-s.text: Well, I think it's about time you sort yourself out with an upgrade! You should check in with Jim. I'm sure he'll have something fitting. Now, avast!

4KN0LY.player: I'm afraid I don't have it on me.

4KN0LY.speaker: 'Squawking' Steve Beanie
4KN0LY.text: Well, go get it sailor! Heave to!
